title: kb!: a person reports on the session's last kb answer from the prompt, at no model tokens
goal: A prompt starting kb!: in Claude Code is handled by kb_hook.py beside kb: and kb+:: it writes one 'feedback' row joined to the session's last kb entry (its session_id and prompt_id, and that entry's pack handle when it has one), reads path:line references, urls and the words wrong, stale, outdated and missing deterministically into the closed fields of kb_feedback, keeps the rest as a rule-redacted comment with class unclassified in the local spool only (D-rd64qovu), prints a one-line receipt naming the id and what will check it, and blocks the prompt so no model turn runs; a kb!: with no earlier kb entry in the session says so and records nothing; the hook makes no network call (D-gmrjivyw).

run:
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
env = dict(os.environ, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=str(tmp), CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=str(Path(".").resolve()))
spool = tmp / "querylog" / "spool"
spool.mkdir(parents=True)
(spool / "sess1.jsonl").write_text(json.dumps({"id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", "ts": "2026-10-16T10:00:00Z", "surface": "kb_hook", "v": 1, "session_id": "sess1", "prompt_id": "p1", "question": "how does x work", "verdict": "good", "lines": [], "pack": "P-0123abcd"}) + "\n")
ev = {"hook_event_name": "UserPromptSubmit", "session_id": "sess1", "prompt_id": "p2", "prompt": "kb!: that answer is wrong, see kb/public/x/y.md:12"}
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/kb_hook.py"], input=json.dumps(ev), capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=25)
out = json.loads(p.stdout) if p.stdout.strip() else {}
assert out.get("decision") == "block", p.stdout
rows = [json.loads(l) for f in spool.rglob("*.jsonl") for l in f.read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()]
fb = [r for r in rows if r.get("surface") == "feedback"]
assert fb and fb[0].get("session_id") == "sess1", rows

notes: Premise: _tools/kb_hook.py handles kb: and kb+: only; a person who sees a wrong answer has no channel but a new prompt the pipeline reads as another lookup. AGENTS.md is capped at 4096 bytes and nearly full: naming kb!: there needs a cut elsewhere in the same commit (wc -c AGENTS.md). Comment text: D-rd64qovu.
